xml/name#

XML names with namespaces.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let name = XmlName(namespace: "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom", local: "feed", prefix: "");
name.local_name();          // "feed"
name.lexical();             // "feed", or "atom:feed" with a prefix

XML names with namespaces.
